findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed multiple cold held temperature control for food safety (TCS) foods in the open air cooler to have an internal temperature above 41F:
1) Hard boiled eggs had an ambient temperature of 51F, and probed at 45F. Three total packages of hard boiled eggs (two were in compliance) were probed for internal temperatures and voluntarily discarded by the person in charge (PIC). 
2) Two containers of Chobani yogurt were probed and one had an internal temperatures of 45F (the other had an internal temperature that was in compliance). Both containers were voluntarily discarded by the PIC.
3) Egg and dill salad sandwich and carrot cake had ambient temperatures of 48F. When probed they had internal temperature that were in compliance, however were discarded to be probed.
CORRECTED- probed items were discarded, and items in the open air cooler were pushed backwards. Ambient thermometers in the cooling unit show proper cold holding temperatures. Ensure all TCS items are monitored to be cold holding at 41F or less.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed caulking around mop sink to contain an accumulation of black soil debris. Ensure caulking is cleaned and replace by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
The under counter cooler near the roller grillers was observed holding an ambient temperature of 50F. Hardboiled eggs inside were observed at 47F and were voluntarily discarded. Other foods were observed at 45F (humus, cookie dough, yogurt drinks) and were moved to a functioning cooler. Ensure the cooler is working properly to hold foods at 41F or below.
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Cardboard is currently used to cover the drain in the soft serve dispenser area. Replace the cardboard and use a material that is smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Quat sanitizer from the wall-mounted dispenser was observed at 150ppm. PIC indicated that she will put in a work order and ensure sanitizer dispenser is functioning properly. Sanitizer will be mixed by hand until the dispenser is fixed.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label (200-400ppm), and water with 500ppm hardness or less. [P]

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment: Shrink wrapped packages of bottled water were stored on a display located outside in front of the building. Bottled water display needs to be relocated inside the building and kept inside moving forward.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11 Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location; where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 Sanitizer solution was not available for use during inspection. Staff were advised sanitizer solution needs to be available in a sani-bucket or spray bottle during all hours of operation. Sani-bucket was prepared and placed out in the service area for use.
Sanitizer shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12 Store manager was designated PIC at time of inspection and has a CFM that expired in June of this year. Manager noted they along with three other employees are in the process of getting scheduled to take a food manger course for certification.
Person in charge at the time of inspection shall be a certified food protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an accredited program.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Signed copies of employee health reporting agreements were not available for any employees at the time of inspection. PIC was able to print a copy of the reporting agreement from available documents in the manager’s system. PIC and staff working at the time of inspection reviewed and signed reporting agreements. All other staff will review and sign copies when they arrive for their next shift. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring, and maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under ¶ 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Paper towels were not available at the back handsink by the 3 part sink. Paper towels were provided. This same issue was observed during routine inspections in 2018 and 2019 and corrected at the time of inspection. Ensure that soap and paper towels are always stocked at all handsinks to allow for proper handwashing. 
Each handwashing sink shall be provided with Individual, disposable towels or another approved drying option.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Soap dispenser was empty at the back handwashing sink by the 3 part sink. Soap was provided during inspection.
Each handwashing sink shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-201.11 Spray bottle of glass cleaner was observed on a shelf in back storage above coffee storage. Spray bottle was removed from the area. A spray bottle of sanitizer was later observed stored on the same shelf above coffee storage. Spray bottle was relocated to a surface away from food storage in the food prep area. Ensure proper storage of chemicals between uses.
Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they cannot contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, single service and single use articles by separating toxic materials by spacing or partitioning and locating toxic materials in an area that is not above food, equipment, utensils, linens, single service and single use articles.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Purell Foodservice Sanitizer spray was observed in the food prep area. PIC was advised test strips are required if the product is being used for sanitization of food contact surfaces. Test strips can be ordered through Purell. Spray bottle of quat sanitizer was placed in the food service area, and Purell was removed from the area. Ensure use on general surfaces only for Purell spray until test strips are available. 
A test kit that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solutions in mg/L shall be provided.
